verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs show HR-linked offboarding checks: the FreeAgent integration 'helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.' There are also access-check monitoring, access-review pages and a JumpCloud identity integration, which support the 'every leaver lost access' half thinly. Nothing in the pack covers onboarding checklists or proof that new hires completed training. Missing for 10: onboarding checklists, training-completion tracking, detailed HR-sync documentation, offboarding access-revocation evidence beyond page titles, independent corroboration.
